newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares in need of inspiration at open.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares in need of inspiration at open.

text.p: Singapore shares were in need of inspiration in early trade on Monday, dealers said.
"There's a bit of window dressing for Singapore blue chips and some interest in property stocks, but otherwise it's a very quiet day," one dealer said.
The pre-Christmas lull saw a slow start to the week's trade with the benchmark Singapore Straits Times Industrials Index (STII) slipping back 0.39 points to 2,195.78 at 0225 GMT.
Institutional and retail buying were muted in early trading and market volume was a thin 12.7 million shares at 0225 GMT, producing 83 losers against 40 gainers.
Leading the early gainers was motor retailer Cycle & Carriage, which moved up Singapore $0.20 to $16.70. Jardine Matheson was also steadily up U.S. $0.10 to $6.45.
Early losers were Creative Technology, down S$0.30 to S$13.20 and tobacco company Rothmans Industries, which slipped back S$0.20 to S$5.95.
News about the date of the Singapore general election, expected later today, was not thought likely by dealers to lift activity greatly.
"I don't think they'll be any element of surprise in the result," one trader said.
